actions.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[]

agentPresentation.description: Optional identity in the existing rewriting and review header.

announcement.description: Speak status changes politely, or leave announcements to the host.

children.description: The text region, as SelectionActions wraps it.

decisions.description: Keyed by each change's first segment id. Without it the pattern keeps its own.

onAction.type: (id: string, selection: { text: string; start: number; end: number; }) => void
onAction.description: The person chose an action: the selected text, and where it sits in the region's text content.

onApply.description: The text with the accepted changes, and the range it replaces.

reviewPlacement.description: Floating by default; inline keeps the review below the text in document flow.

selection.description: The range the suggestion is for, as onAction reported it. Without it, the last action's range.

suggestion.type: { title: ReactNode; segments: readonly DiffSegment[]; } | undefined
suggestion.description: Keep it through applied, with `decisions`: the receipt counts them.
